title: Cap. IV Arg. 7: τρόπος of mercy and justice is the one true predestination — Rom. 9:22
pass_a_gloss: Argument 7. The manner according to which the Lord God shows his mercy in some, his justice in others, is the true and only predestination; But the decree of saving believers on the one side, of condemning unbelievers on the other, is such a manner: Therefore this decree is the true and only predestination. They say the Major is admitted by the Contraremonstrants themselves: the Minor is proved from Rom. 9:22, where by vessels of mercy and of wrath believers and unbelievers are understood.
pass_b_english: Arg. 7. The τρόπος by which the Lord shows his mercy in some and his justice in others is the true and only predestination. But the decree to save believers on one side and condemn unbelievers on the other is such a τρόπος. Therefore that decree is the true and only predestination. They say Contraremonstrants admit the Major; the Minor they prove from Rom. 9:22, where vessels of mercy and of wrath mean believers and unbelievers.
source_text: Arg. 7. Τρόπος secundum quem Dominus Deus in aliis ostendit suam misericordiam, in aliis justitiam, est vera et unica praedestinatio; Atqui decretum salvandi credentes ex una, condemnandi incredulos ex altera parte, est talis τρόπος: Ergo hoc decretum est vera et unica praedestinatio. Dicunt Majorem ab ipsis Contraremonstrantibus admitti: Minorem probari ex Rom. ix. 22. ubi per vasa misericordiae et irae intelliguntur credentes et increduli.
